name: Shirase Nozomi
source:
Zodiac: Sagittarius
Precise weight: 46.4 kg.

A girl who has been living next door to Takuma all the time and has been attending the same school as him always. Some years they have been in the same class, but not all of the time. (For example, they are not in the same class in the game.) Nozomi is the one girl Takuma can easily talk to, they seem to be close friends who share a platonic relationship. Nozomi can be described as is hardworking, caring and kind, but also rather nosy. It seems that the feelings she bears for Takuma aren't necessarily just friendly...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031014071144/http://www.pinkpineapple.co.jp/pinpai/xmas/character/character.html]official website[/url].]
